Commentary.Commentary: We're back with Sri Lanka's reply with the bat. The Bangla Tigers get into a quick huddle before spreading on the field. A little over 30 minutes left for Lunch and it's a tricky period for Dimuth Karunaratne and Lahiru Thirimanne to negotiate. Can Bangladesh strike early? Abu Jayed has the new cherry in hand as he gets ready to steam in...

The Lankan bowling was not poor but there wasn't much on the surface for the bowlers. They also got carried away in the first hour of Day 1 and then dropping Najmul Hossain Shanto didn't help them either. Still, the bowling of Vishwa Fernando was a big positive while the spinners mainly struggled. Let's see how their batsmen respond to this big total in front of them. Stay tuned...

Summarizing Bangladesh's batting, it was a good toss to win and a great decision to bat first. There was a good covering of grass on the surface but that didn't bother the touring team. They lost the first wicket early but then Tamim Iqbal and Najmul Hossain Shanto put on a century stand to hand the advantage to Bangladesh. The former was unlucky to miss out on his ton but the latter went on to notch up his maiden Test ton. His marathon stand with skipper Mominul Haque was the focal point of the Bangla innings as the pair made Sri Lanka sweat hard for the third wicket. Liton Das and Mushfiqur Rahim also played crucial hands in adding some quick runs towards the end.

Bangladesh's coach, Russell Domingo says that it's been a good two days for them and he is really pleased. Hopes that the pitch will start to spin and there will be some uneven bounce. Admits that they missed the opportunity to up the scoring in the second session on Day 2. Adds that these are the learnings for them. Tells that they had a tough couple of weeks against West Indies back home and it was not as if they got dominated. States that they don't want to get too ahead of themselves in this Test match.

We are all set to begin Day 3. The Sri Lanka players are out in the middle. Mushfiqur Rahim and Liton Das will resume their innings for Bangladesh. Dhananjaya de Silva will start the proceedings for Sri Lanka.

Pitch report - Very, very good conditions. The surface is still good for batting. There will be even bounce and the batsmen can play their strokes. There are roughs on both sides of the pitch and the spinners can exploit them.

The plans for the day looks set. If not declaring, Bangladesh would like to bat in T20 mode and stretch their score beyond 500 in the first hour. Sri Lanka's aim would be to first stop them from achieving that target and then bat with responsibility when their turn comes. 98 overs to be bowled in the day and we're in for a fascinating day. Stay tuned for more.

With the major chunk of last session sacrificed to bad light on Day 2, vital time has got wasted. Bangladesh could have wanted to score quickly and put Sri Lanka to bat late last evening but that wasn't possible. Now, things have to move fast if we have to see a result in this match. The touring team has almost got the immunity as after putting 400-plus on the board, losing this Test match looks unlikely.

New day, new hope! Let's set the ball rolling. This Test match enters into its moving day and it has to get on the hot wheels now. So far only one inning has been possible and even that's incomplete unless Bangladesh have done the overnight declaration and we aren't aware of it.
... Day 3, Session 1 ...

Right then! Sri Lanka are still in this game as they have bowled very well and did not give away any easy runs. It will be interesting to watch Bangladesh's approach. Will they declare overnight or will they continue to bat longer? We will have to wait and see. Day 3 will have a 15-minute early start and 98 overs are scheduled to be bowled on Day 3. That will start at 0945 local (0415 GMT). Do join us then, Cheers and take care.

Sri Lanka were much better with the ball than they were on Day 1. They bowled very tightly and did not give away free runs and they kept on coming at the Bangladeshi batsmen. It was good to see the energy on the field as well as they fielded well and they did not let their shoulders drop even though they were way behind in the game. Suranga Lakmal bowled well, while Lahiru Kumara ran in all day and was rewarded with a wicket. Dhananjaya de Silva bowled with control while Wanindu Hasaranga was decent as well.

Bangladesh started the day off in fine fashion as in session, they looked to consolidate and did not lose a wicket with Mominul Haque and Najmul Hossain Shanto continuing from where they left off on Day 1. Najmul scored his 150 while Mominul reached his ton. Bangladesh would have hoped for more quick runs in session 2 but that did not come as they lost Hossain Shanto while Mominul went into a shell after that and fell too. Rahim and Das since then have stitched a 50-run stand before Bad Light called the day off. Overall, Bangladesh would have wanted to get quick runs and it will be interesting to see their approach on Day 3.

Update 1700 Local (1130 GMT) - Well, that is Stumps on Day 2! Bad light forces an early call off and it is a sad end to a day that promised so much. But at the end of it, Bangladesh remain on top but Sri Lanka have done well to stay in it as they bowled very tightly on Day 2.

Bangladesh, on the other hand, needed to show more intent in this session. They were well ahead in the game in the first session and many would have hoped that Bangladesh will look for quick runs in the second but that did not happen. They lost two wickets and that put their run rate down. Mushfiqur Rahim has struggled while Liton Das has just come out and has played with intent. They would look to get some quick runs before they declare and put Sri Lanka to bat while the hosts would hope that they can bowl just they did in the second session. Join us at 1500 local (0930 GMT) for the final session of Day 2.

A session which has belonged to Sri Lanka! They are way behind in the game but in this session, they were far more disciplined and did not give away many runs. They were tight with their lines and lengths and they were rewarded with two wickets. Lahiru Kumara was good with the ball as he picked up the wicket of Najmul Hossain Shanto while de Silva was tight and got the wicket of Mominul Haque. The others too bowled well in this session and they have not given much away in this session.

The star of Day 1, Najmul Hossain Shanto comes up for a quick chat. He starts by saying that he is feeling much better now and a bit relieved as he has worked very hard on his game. Adds that he believed in himself. Talks about the mental side of the game and mentions that he tries to be positive. Tells that he just watches the ball and plays according to his strength. Shares that the pitch looks good for batting and they will have to bat well and play good cricket. Thinks that on the last two days, it might spin and help the bowlers.

Sri Lanka had a tough day in the field and not sure, they expected it. Dimuth Karunaratne anyway wanted to bowl on a green-looking surface but as it turned out, his bowlers got carried away in the first hour and then the pitch settled down into a good one for batting. Asitha Fernando was the only bowler to taste some success as he claimed both the wickets to fall in the day's play. The rest of the bowlers weren't too penetrative. A word of praise for Lahiru Kumara who kept on trying even at the fag end and cranked up his pace to trouble the batsmen.

It turned out to be a great toss to win and Mominul Haque's decision to bat first was backed up by some strong batting show. Tamim Iqbal and Najmul Hossain Shanto steadied the ship after an early loss of wicket and their century stand didn't allow Sri Lanka any sniff. Iqbal was unlucky to miss out on his hundred but Shanto batted with great patience and eventually notched up his maiden Test ton in the final session. Along with Mominul, he has constructed yet another unbeaten century stand and that has put Bangladesh in a commanding position.

Good length ball on off, defended off the back foot.
FOUR BYES! A wayward bouncer down the leg side, at 142 kph, the batsman leaves it alone and Niroshan only manages some parts of his gloves on it. Ends up deflecting it behind to the fine leg fence.
Edgy! Good length ball on off, at 145.2 kph, Haque is squared up in defense and gets an outside edge. It drops in front of gully.
Bouncer at 142 kph, around middle and leg, Mominul allows through to the keeper.
Lahiru is still cranking it up. This one is 144 kph, short and on middle, Shanto stands back and turns it behind square leg for one.
An 89 mph short delivery on off, Shanto pulls it across the line but finds the fielder on the leg side.

FOUR LEG BYES! Good length ball around off, at 146 kph, shaping in with extra bounce, Shanto fails to defend and is hit on the back thigh. The bowler turns to appeal and the ball speeds past gully for a boundary. Too high!
Pitches it up and outside off, Mominul drives it off his front foot to extra cover.
Straying on middle and leg, Mominul clips it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
In the zone outside off, that is left alone for the keeper to collect.
Beautiful delivery. Lakmal delivers a good length ball outside off and gets it to shape back in, Mominul tries to poke at it but misses.
Outswinger, but it's too wide outside off to bother the batsman, Mominul shoulders arms.
A length ball on off, angling in, Haque allows the ball to reach him and then he dead bats it near the pitch.
Fuller length ball on middle, Mominul flicks in front of square leg for a run.
Speedy delivery, on a good length but wide outside off, Haque offers no shot.
Edged but safe! Back of a length ball close to off, Mominul is hurried up as he fends at it. The outside edge doesn't carry to gully.
On middle, defended close to the body towards short mid-wicket.
Very full in length on off, Haque gets forward and tries to drive. But it takes the inner half and rolls to short mid-wicket.
Angling into the batsman, a length ball around off, Shanto closes the face of his bat and helps it behind square leg for a run.
Lahiru Kumara to operate from the other end now.
FOUR! Excellent timing! Lakmal once again is very straight with his line, it's on the pads and Mominul flicks it sweetly through square leg for a boundary.
In the channel outside off, Mominul shoulders arms.
Once again there is movement but it's around middle and leg, Haque defends it to square leg.
Beaten! There is movement and extra bounce with the second new ball. Lakmal lands it on a fuller length outside off, Haque pushes at it and misses.
Some movement back into the batsman from outside off, Mominul defends it back to the bowler.
Too straight in line first up and it's nudged down to fine leg for a run.
The second new ball has been taken. Suranga Lakmal is back on and he will be operating from 'round the wicket.

Drinks break. Time for the players to rehydrate themselves. A plate of fruit salad is also coming out. Looking tempting. As far as this session goes, Bangladesh have not put a single foot wrong and the current pair has batted with ease. The second new ball is now due and the Lankans would be hoping for some success. 10 overs left in the day's play and we will be going into extra time for sure.
Floated and wide outside off, strokes square of the wicket on the off side for a couple.
Full and floated outside off, Shanto strokes it to long off for one.
Poor fielding! Too full and on middle, Shanto eases it down to wide mid on for a run. The fielder there slides but parries it to long off. The batsmen cross for one more.
Quicker one, outside off and skidding in, Mominul gets forward and hits it through cover-point for a run.
A slider on off, Mominul defends it close to his front pad.
Flighted and on off, driven to long off for a single.
Floated and full on off, Mominul defends it in front of his pads.
Too full and on middle, driven down the track and the silly mid on fielder made the stop.
Loopy and full on middle, Shanto presents a straight bat and eases it down to long on for one.
Very full and landing on middle, Shanto sweeps but finds the fielder at short fine leg.
Short and on off, pulled in front of square leg for a single.
Loopy and full on middle, flicked on the leg side, straight to short mid-wicket.
Flatter and shorter on off, Hossain gets back and pushes it towards the bowler.
Too full and on off, Mominul knocks it down to long off for another run. FIFTY FOR MOMINUL! His 14th in Test cricket.
Drives and drives well. A full ball has been forced down to long off for a single.
Again, a delivery holding its line outside off, Najmul pokes at it in defense and gets beaten.
Tossed up ball outside off, going straight on, Shanto pushes at it and misses.
Full and flighted, thrown wide outside off, Shanto drives but fails to beat the diving cover fielder.
Skidding down the leg side from middle, Shanto works it out to square leg for one.
Short and on off, punched off the back foot to short mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball on off, Shanto lunges and presents a straight bat in defense.
Hangs on the back foot and helps it to square leg for a single.
Walks forward and brings his bat and pad together in defense.
Fuller and on off, it's driven off the inner half past the short mid-wicket fielder to mid on for one.
Fullish and on middle, Mominul leans forward and defends it on the leg side.
The batsman has just watchfully blocked this out.
Forces a full ball to mid on and scampers across to the other end for a single.
Flatter and shorter on middle, Shanto goes back and tickles it to short mid-wicket.
Once again Shanto is on the front foot in defense.
Fuller and off, defended back to the bowler.
Fullish and off, Mominul is forward and he defends it back to the bowler.
Shortish and on off, helped off the pads to mid-wicket. The fielder fumbled but no run taken.
Too full and on middle, Haque sweeps across the line but finds square leg.
Loopy and full on off, drifting in, Haque presses forward and once again pushes it back to Wanindu.
Fuller and on off, driven back to the bowler.
Spinning down the leg side, Mominul stands back and just helps it down to fine leg for two runs.
Quicker and fuller on off, defended back to complete the over.

FOUR! MAIDEN TEST HUNDRED FOR SHANTO! Full and floated outside off, Shanto leans forward and thumps his drive past the cover fielder for a boundary. This has been a high-class knock by the young man and he raises his bat to acknowledge his teammates. Well played, Shanto! The century stand comes up as well.
Fullish and on off, Shanto defends it with an angled bat to the off side.
Flatter and full on middle, blocked back to the bowler again off the front foot.
Loopy and full on off, defended off the front foot.
Play and a miss! Full and flighted outside off, Shanto tries to drive but it spins past his bat. Nervy for the batsman in his 90s.
Slightly short and on off, Mominul goes back and hits it across the line, finds short mid-wicket.
Stretches forward to a full ball outside off and defends it to the off side.
Flicks it with the spin to the leg side but fails to find the gap at square leg.
Floated and full on off, Mominul drives it down and the short mid-wicket fielder stops it to his right.
Too full in length and on middle, Shanto drills it past the diving short mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Flighted and full on middle, Haque flicks it through square leg for a single.
Shortish and outside off, Shanto pushes it straight to point.
Way wide outside off, Shanto is not going to chase it.
Shortish and outside off, Mominul steers it behind backward point for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, left alone.
Fuller in length around off, angling in, MH is forward as he drives it to mid on.
A length ball angling in from around off, that is defended solidly off the front foot.
Floated one, full and on off, Najmul defends it off the front foot again. Looking in no hurry.
A touch on the shorter side, spinning in, Shanto goes on the back foot in defense.
Spinning in from outside off, Shanto once again gets forward in defense.
Slower through the air, full and on off, Najmul presses forward in defense.
Fuller and on middle, defended with firm hands to mid-wicket.
Full and flighted on middle, Shanto flicks but finds short mid-wicket.
On a length and around off, angling in, Mominul allows the ball to come to him and then pushes it defensively to the off side.
Back of a length ball on off, Mominul defends it from the back foot to covers.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, it's left alone.
Moves to 97! Taking baby steps towards his maiden Test hundred. Shanto gets back to a good length ball and works it in front of square leg for a run.
In the zone outside off, trying to lure the batsman into a drive, Shanto takes his front leg forward, watches the line and senses the intent of the bowler, before making a leave.
Angles in a length ball on off, Shanto is right behind the line in defense.
A little bit of width outside off, Shanto pushes it with an angled bat to point for a run.
Loopy and full around off, Shanto flicks it off the inner half to short mid-wicket. The fielder there collects and has a quick shy at the non-striker's end. Nothing doing though.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it to the off side.
Eases a full ball down to long on and hands the strike to his partner who is on 95.
Fuller and on middle, Mominul tries to flick but gets a soft leading edge back towards the bowler.
Loopy and full on middle, Haque flicks it to short mid-wicket.
A touch short in length and wide outside off, Haque stays back and guides it to deep point for one.
Beautiful shot. Full in length and wide outside off, Mominul reaches out and drives it to deep cover for two.
Fuller and closer to off, angling in, Shanto opens the face of the bat and pushes it to point for a run.
Good length ball in the area outside off, Shanto watches it closely and then lets it go.
Too full in length and outside off, Shanto pushes it off his front foot to short cover.
Good length ball on off, Shanto defends it from the back foot to the off side.
Extra flight on this one, Mominul walks forward and eases his drive to mid off.
This time it is short and wide outside off, cut through backward point for a single.
Flatter and short on off, Shanto goes back and punches it to short mid-wicket.
Gets on the front foot and brings his bat and pad together in defense.
Presses forward to a full ball and jams it out to the off side.
A nicely tossed up ball, landing full on off, Shanto pushes it back to the bowler.
A hint of movement in the air as it lands on a fuller length outside off, Haque drives it down off the inner half to mid on.
Hurls across a length ball in the channel outside off, Mominul Haque has nothing to do with it.
Uses the angle of the bowler and helps it to the leg side, finds short mid-wicket.
On a length and outside off, angling in, Mominul defends it from the back foot to the off side.
Back of a length ball outside off, Mominul defends it from the back foot and it comes off the bottom half. Rolls behind towards the keeper.
Begins his new spell with a short ball on off, Shanto pulls it behind square leg for a single.
Vishwa Fernando is into the attack after the break. 2/52 in his 11 overs so far.

Drinks break. Bangladesh continue to do well and have kept Sri Lanka at bay. The current stand is growing and reaching the century mark. Shanto is also approaching his maiden Test hundred. So far, Sri Lanka have failed to create any opening. Can they do it in the next half?
Innovative! Loopy and full, landing on the rough outside off, Mominul reverse sweeps it against the spin to third man for a couple.
Tossed up ball on off, MH defends it off the front foot to the leg side.
Loopy and full around off, Haque wrists it across the line but finds mid-wicket.
Quicker and on off, Mominul gets back and defends it to short mid-wicket.
Fuller this time, around off, Shanto drives it from the inner half to long on for one.
Tossed up ball, a full toss on off, Mominul steps down and eases it to long on for a run.
Bouncer and around off, Shanto easily sways away from that one.
Fullish and on off, Shanto bunts it to mid on, looks for a run initially but then shouts no.
Angles in from outside off, a length ball, it's defended from the back foot to the off side.
Width on offer outside off, shorter in length, Mominul plays a controlled square cut through point for a single.
Fuller in length on off, Mominul is on the front foot and defends it back.
Good length ball on off, angling in, Haque defends it from the back foot to the leg side.
Shorter and quicker, turning in from outside off, Shanto goes back and helps it to short mid-wicket.
Lunges to a full ball on off and defends it watchfully.
Flighted and full outside off, Shanto pushes it to mid off and looks for a run, decides against it seeing the fielder.
A walking flick shot past the short mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Tossed up ball on middle, defended off the pads to mid-wicket.
Drags his length short and bowls it on middle, Shanto goes back and pulls it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Change. Wanindu Hasaranga is into the attack now.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Mominul tries to be adventurous there! Short and wide outside off, the Bangla skipper attempts to play the upper cut but misses.
Good length ball on off, Mominul stays back to get on top of the bounce and then defends it back.
Fuller and closer to off, Haque flicks but finds short mid-wicket again.
Effort ball. Back of a length and on off, Mominul goes on the back foot and pushes it to covers.
Fuller and on off, Haque flicks it with the angle of the bowler to the leg side. Finds mid-wicket.
Flatter and shorter outside off, it's guided wide of point for three runs.
Gets forward to a full ball and blocks it watchfully.
FOUR! Short and on middle, Mominul goes on the back foot and pulls it powerfully to the deep mid-wicket fence.
The batsman has just watchfully blocked this out.

EDGED AND DROPPED! Hang on, it's a no ball again. So it wouldn't have mattered. Fuller in length and outside off, Mominul tries to drive but gets a faint edge it seems. Dickwella fails to gather the ball. The Ultra Edge shows no bat. Hmm...
Into the 90s, Shanto! Full and outside off, it's driven past the diving bowler to long off for a run.
Fuller and on off, driven through the line but back to the bowler.
Flighted ball, full and on off, defended back off the front foot.
Fuller in length and on middle, defended back past the bowler to mid on.
Good length ball on middle, turned through backward square leg for a single.
The batsman has just blocked that from his crease.
Fuller and closer to off, angling in, Shanto meets it with a defensive bat.
Sliding down the leg side, Najmul uses the pace of the bowler and nudges it towards fine leg for a brace.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it past the bowler to mid off.
Lahiru Kumara is brought back into the attack. 12-1-53-0 are his figures so far...
Uppish but on the bounce to the fielder! Once again Mominul gets tempted by seeing the flight and tries to play a booming cover drive. It takes the outside edge but goes safely to point.
Nicely flighted, full and outside off, Mominul slices his attempted drive to point.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Short and wide outside off, turning away, Mominul waits on the back foot and guides his square cut wide of backward point for a boundary.
Floated and full outside off, Mominul plays an uppish drive but it doesn't carry to the fielder at extra cover.
Flatter through the air, a touch short and on middle, Haque gets back and hits it past mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Loopy and full around off, Shanto drives it past the short cover fielder for a run down to long off.
Fuller and on off, pushed defensively to mid off to complete the over.

Shout for an lbw! Not given. A length ball on middle, skidding down with some extra zip, Shanto fails to flick and is hit high on the pads. It deflects to point and the batsmen cross. The appeal is not entertained. The umpire waits for Sri Lanka to decide to review it and when they decide against it, he signals a leg bye.
This time Lakmal goes too straight with his line, angling down, Mominul works it behind square leg and picks up a single.
Fuller in length and on off, angling in, Haque is half-forward as he defends it near the surface.
In the channel outside off, on a driving length, Mominul is not going to commit himself into any kind of a shot.
Angles in a length ball on off, Mominul offers a dead bat in defense.
Flatter and shorter on off, Najmul goes back and pushes it towards the bowler.
The batsman has just watchfully blocked this out.

FOUR! PUT AWAY! Short in length on middle, sitting up to the batsman, Shanto immediately goes deep inside the crease and punches it wide of mid on for a boundary. Moves to 85 and this partnership is worth 55 now!
Fuller and on off, defended off the front foot yet again.
Extra flight this time, full and on off, Shanto defends it off his front foot.
Full and flighted on middle, defended from the back foot to the leg side.
Once again the angle into the batsman means Mominul has no issues in working it on the leg side, towards mid-wicket. Not in the gap though.
Uses the angle of the bowler and defends it easily to short mid-wicket.
Yet another attempted flick shot grabbing the inside half of the blade as it rolls to short mid-wicket.

Fuller length ball angling in from around off, Mominul flicks it from the inner half to short mid-wicket. Diving stop there by Hasaranga and he scores a direct hit at the striker's end as well. Mominul is safe though.
Angling in from outside off, landing on a fuller length, Mominul  pushes it to the off side.
Lands it on a length and outside off, from 'round the wicket, Mominul plants his front leg forward to cover the line and then shoulders arms.
Shortens the length around off, Shanto goes back to punch it through the line but finds the cover fielder.
Fullish and on off, pushed back to the bowler with a straight bat.
Flighted and full on off, blocked off the front foot to the off side again.
Once again Najmul gets on the front foot and defends it to the off side.
Full and floated on off, Shanto presses forward and defends it off the inner half to the leg side.
Flighted delivery, outside off, left alone.
Dhananjaya de Silva to bowl from the other end. A slip and short leg in place.
Identical to the last delivery, again leaving the batsman outside off, Mominul sticks back and defends it to point.
Decides to bowl from over the wicket and angles across a length ball on off, Mominul plays it close to his body and pushes it towards backward point.
Pitches it up and around off, Mominul strides forward and defends it to the off side.
Short in length and wide outside off, Shanto cuts it off his back foot through point. The fielder chases it down near the fence and saves a run.
The batsman has just watchfully blocked this out.
Starts from 'round the wicket and angles in a length ball on off, Shanto defends it to the leg side.

We're back for the evening session. Bangladesh have done a commendable job so far and would be looking to continue with the good work. 37 overs left in the day's play and their plan should be to get around 300-325 without losing many wickets. Let's see whether the tired Lankan bowlers make a comeback or not. Here is Suranga Lakmal...
... DAY 1, SESSION 3 ...

Once again the Sri Lankan bowlers were not spot on with their lines and lengths. They didn't put enough pressure to trouble the batters throughout the session. While there is hardly any assistance off the deck, consistent and probing lines and lengths would've made some difference. Will they be able to do so when they return for the final session or will these two batters continue batting the way they are doing. Join us for the final session to find out.

The good thing though for Bangladesh was that Shanto did not let things get out of their control as he marched on nicely. He got to his half ton and along with skipper Haque is batting nicely. The duo has added 48 between them and would look to return and pile on the runs for the team.

Another wonderful session for Bangladesh! They have added nearly 100 runs and have lost just one wicket. Tamim was the man who fell in this session and he would have been mighty disappointed because he was all but set for a massive knock, on this wonderful surface. However, it was a glorious innings while it lasted from the Bangladeshi veteran.
Looped up and around off, blocked solidly. Wnd with that, it is TEA ON DAY 1.
Full and wide outside off, driven through mid off for a single. 200 up for Bangladesh.

On off, Shanto comes forward and plays it back to the bowler.
Floated around off, slower through the air, kept out.
Shortish and outside off, chopped through point for one.
Full and wide outside off, driven to cover once again.
Full and just outside off, poked to point.
Shanto is taking his time. Maybe he wants to ensure that this is the last over before Tea.
Fullish and outside off, Shanto pushes it to cover.
This one is angled in from around off, Shanto blocks off the back foot.
Good length and around off one more time, Shanto gets behind the line to defend.
Length ball, around off, kept out.
Full and on middle, this one is eased down to long on for a single.
Loopy fuller ball around off, blocked back to the bowler once again.
On middle, played back to the bowler.
Fuller and around middle, Shanto gets forward and tucks it to the leg side.
Flat and around middle, clipped to mid-wicket.
Floated outisde off, on a fuller length. Blocked.
FOUR! Lovely shot to end the over! A back of a length ball, it is outside off, Mominul rides the bounce and punches it through backward point for a boundary.
Short and around middle, worked to the left of Oshada at short fine leg who makes a good stop on that side.
Back of a length ball around middle, worked behind square on the leg side for one.
FOUR! Pulled away nicely! A short ball, this one is just outside off, Shanto decides to take it on and nails the pull wide of deep square leg for a boundary.
Short and just outside off, punched to mid off.
Good length and around off, kept out off the back foot.
Tossed up and outside off, another easy run as this one is driven through the covers.
Shortish and just outside off, punched to sweeper cover for one.
Full and around off, tucked towards mid-wicket.
Slower and shortish, worked on the leg side.
Full and on middle, this one is flicked to mid on

Back of a length once again, Haque keeps it out. A decent over from Lahiru.
High full toss but dipped as it got close to the batter. Kept out. Maybe this slipped out of his hand.
Short again, poked to backward point without any issues.
Back of a length on middle, clipped towards short leg. The fielder there does well to stop.
Good length and around off, poked to point this time.
Back of a length and around off, kept out.
FOUR! Poor ball and Shanto pounces on it. Short and wide outside off, Shanto cuts it hard through point for a boundary. Good finish to the over.
On middle, clipped to deep mid-wicket for one.
On middle, pushed to mid on.
Another sharp single. This is excellent from these two. A flighted ball, it is once again driven to mid off. They call for the single again and steal it nicely.
Flat and around middle, clipped towards square leg for nothing.
Full and around off, pushed to mid off for a single. Smart from the skipper.
Single to end the over! Full and around off, Haque pushes it to mid on again. This time they take off for the single and make it easily in the end.
Tossed up again, driven to mid off again.
Floated around off, kept out.
Loopy ball around off, driven to mid off for nothing.
Short and just outside off, cut to point this time.
On middle, tucked on the leg side.
Shortish and around off, kept out.
Back of a length and outside off, punched to mid off.
Around off on a length, kept out.
Good length and around middle, worked on the leg side for a single.
Down the leg side, on a fuller length. Mominul looks to flick but misses.
A length ball around off, Haque tucks it through mid-wicket and takes two.
Lahiru Kumara comes back again.
On middle, worked towards mid-wicket for nothing.
Full and on middle, Mominul clips it down to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up and outside off, pushed through covers for one.
Floated around off, blocked off the front foot.
Tossed up and outside off, pushed to cover.
Wanindu Hasaranga is back. Just 2 overs so far.
Flat and around off, worked on the leg side.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Full and around off, pushed to mid off.
Short and wide outside off, left alone.
Very full and around off, kept out.
Full and just around off, pushed to mid on this time.
FOUR! GLORIOUS SHOT AGAIN! Full and wide outside off, Haque nails the drive through the covers for a boundary.
Full and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket for nothing.
Full and on middle, kept out.
FOUR! More runs! Shanto doesn't want the spinner to settle in. Full and on the pads, Shanto flicks it wide of the man at mid on for a boundary.
Full and on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
SIX! SHOT! What a shot! Tossed up and just outside off, Shanto meets the ball on the full and just lofts it over long off. Goes all the way. Just the extension of the arms.

Outside off, left alone.

Dhananjaya de Silva to bowl for the first time this session.

Who is in next? It is skipper Mominul Haque who wlaks out in the center.

Thirimanne shows good alertness there and hangs onto the catch. It was traveling but Thirimanne was sharp to gobble the chance. Angled in from around off, pushed to mid-wicket.
Back of a length and around off, pushed on the off side.

FOUR! Cut away and cut away nicely! It also brings up a fine half ton for Shanto. His 2nd in Tests. A short ball, wide outside off, Najmul slashes it through backward point for a boundary. A fine knock from him so far.
Outside off, left alone.

In the channel outside off, left alone.

DRINKS! We were a few minutes away from this mini-break but there was some work that needed to be done near the bowler's landing area. The umpires use the chance to call for the Drinks. Bangladesh have once again going along nicely this session. They haven't had any issues this session and both Tamim and Shanto are looking to continue their good work. Sri Lanka need to strike quickly. Let's see how things go now post this mini-break.
On the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.

Two! Fuller and on middle, this is hit down the ground towards long on for two.
Outside off, this is guided through point for one.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
Change in bowling. Vishwa Fernando, the only man who has got a wicket so far, to bowl now.
Two! On the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for a couple.

Banged into the sufrace again. It is around off, this time Shant gets behind the line to block.

Short ball, on the body, tucked down to deep square leg for one.
Back of a length and around off, kept out.

Banged short and outside off, left alone.

We are back! The Sri Lankan players have walked out in the middle to take their positions in the field. Tamim Iqbal and Najmul Hossain Shanto stride out in the middle too. The duo have added 98 between them so far and would look to extend this partnership this session. Lahiru Kumara will begin the session for Sri Lanka.
... Day 1, Session 2 ...

Fernando struck for Sri Lanka in his very first over but after that, Sri Lanka failed to put more pressure and gave away easy boundaries in the first hour. The likes of Lakmal, Fernando and Kumara failed to bowl probing lines and lengths to trouble the batters in the middle. Dhananjaya de Silva was introduced but he too was taken for a few runs in his 6-over spell. So, the Lankan bowlers have got a big task in hand now when they return for the second session. Join us for the same in a short while.

Both the skippers had different thoughts at the toss. Haque opted to bat but Karunararne suggested that he would've bowled first as he was looking to utilize the moist conditions. However, the Lankan bowlers failed to bowl tight lines and lengths after getting an early success and gave away the advantage to Bangladesh. Tamim has looked in supreme touch and has got to a fine half ton. Shanto has done well to hang around his senior partner in this stand. Bangladesh have scored over 100 runs this session and they will be mighty pleased with how things have gone so far.

Perfect session for Bangladesh. They have scored runs at a brisk pace and despite losing an early wicket, they are placed nicely at the end of the first session. Tamim has raced to his 50 and is looking set for a big one to take his team to a big total. Not a very good session if you are a Sri Lankan fan because the bowlers have not bowled well on a wicket that was supposed to help the pacers in the first session.
A superb nut to end the session! This one tails back in late from outside off. Shanto gets his bat down right at the end, he gets an inside edge onto the pads. That will be LUNCH ON DAY 1!
Length again, this is solidly defended again.

Outside off, left alone.

Change in bowling! Suranga Lakmal returns.
Floats this one full again, Tamim lunges forward and blocks.
Tossed up and around off, kept out off the front foot.

Floated on middle, pushed to the bowler.
Low full toss, it is on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for an easy single.
Tossed up and around off, played back to the bowler.

Saif fell for a duck in the 2nd over itself but Tamim has shown his class as he has stroked a few lovely boundaries in the innings so far. Shanto too has looked solid. While the Sri Lankans have managed to beat the bat on a few occasions, they have not been consistent enough. Will they be able to pull things back after this mini-break?

It is time for the action. The Sri Lankan players make their way in the middle following the two umpires. Tamim Iqbal and Saif Hassan will open the batting for Sri Lanka. Suranga Lakmal will begin the proceedings for Sri Lanka with the ball. All set. Here we go...
Before the action begins, the teams are out for their respective National Anthems. First up in of Bangladesh and it will be followed by Sri Lanka.

Dimuth Karunaratne says that they were looking to bowl first as there is a lot of moisture so they want to use the conditions. Informs that Chandimal misses out and Angelo Mathews is back in the team and also tells that Lahiru Kumara is playing the game as well.

Mominul Haque, the Sri Lankan skipper, says that the wicket looks dry and the spinners will play a big role in the fourth innings. Informs that the they are going with 6 batsmen and 5 bowlers for this game. Tells that they have done good preparation for this game.

Pitch report - Aamir Sohail is in for the pitch report. Sohail says that the wicket has a good covering of grass. Feels there is a lot of moisture and it will assist the pacers at the start. Adds that the batsmen will have to work hard at the start but the wicket will get flat as we move forward in the game.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Dimuth Karunaratne (C), Lahiru Thirimanne, Oshada Fernando, Angelo Mathews, Dhananjaya de Silva, Pathum Nissanka, Niroshan Dickwella (WK), Wanindu Hasaranga, Suranga Lakmal, Vishwa Fernando, Lahiru Kumara.
Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal, Saif Hassan, Najmul Hossain Shanto, Mominul Haque (C), Mushfiqur Rahim, Liton Das (WK), Mehidy Hasan, Taijul Islam, Taskin Ahmed, Abu Jayed, Ebadot Hossain.
Toss - Both the skippers are out in the center for the flip of the coin. Up it goes and it lands in favor of Mominul Haque. Bangladesh will BAT FIRST!

The hosts, Sri Lanka, start firm favorites having shown superb form in West Indies. However, Bangladesh will be eager to challenge the Islanders in this match. So, who will come out on top? We will find out during the course of this game. We welcome you to our coverage. Stay around for the toss and team update.

Yay! It is almost time for Test match cricket. Sri Lanka and Bangladesh battle it out in the longest format of the game amidst all the T20 action going in Indian T20 League in India. Both sides would be eager to put on a show to grab the attention of the fans worldwide to the Test match.
